descripcion_geo: The River Cana (not the city of Cana of Galilee) marked the boundary between the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh.
importancia_estrategica: River border between Ephraim and Manasseh.

historias.titulo: The Cana River as a tribal border
historias.descripcion: The Cana River marked the northern boundary of Ephraim and the southern boundary of Manasseh in the promised land.

historias.titulo: The cities of Manasseh south of Cana
historias.descripcion: Some cities south of the Cana River belonged to Manasseh although they were within the territory of Ephraim.

historias.titulo: Cana in the description of the borders
historias.descripcion: The detailed description of the tribal boundaries in Joshua includes the Cana River as a precise marker.

personajes.rol: Conqueror and distributor of the earth
personajes.descripcion: He used the Cana River as a border between Ephraim and Manasseh.
Cana was the northern limit of their inheritance.
Cana was the southern limit of their inheritance.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Cana of the river: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: The rivers are providential borders in the division of the land: the Cana separates two half tribes of the same patriarch Joseph.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The rivers are providential borders in the division of the land: the Cana separates two half tribes of the same patriarch Joseph.
